where: Cinderhead Mine (the lamplit mine-mouth town of the Lamp-down vigil)
mood: Ink-black galleries where crystal veins and lamp-fire are the only light — a slow miners' hymn, melancholy but faintly warm.
core_styles: low warm horn and pulse-wave lead singing a slow solemn melody that moves by steps
sparse high crystal-chime glints of broken triads
deep sustained synth bass drone on the root
distant dry pick-tap percussion echoing in a cavern
melancholy lamplit mining town in the deep dark, faint warmth of fire-lamps

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet atmospheric entrance: two distant pick-taps echo down the gallery, the low drone opens, and one bright crystal chime glints far above}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the slow miners' melody on the low horn: a rising leap that climbs, then moves only a step or two, solemn and warm, never hurried; a pick-tap every bar}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with the crystal chime answering high above each phrase with a little falling three-note figure, a glint of hope, string pad warming beneath}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the vigil — lowered lamps, a hushed turn to C major, a tender hymn-like chord progression on strings and soft organ, the miners remembering, then sinking back toward A minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the slow miners' melody returns over the drone and pick-taps; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
